page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament band and page number at upper right. Full-width title block and chapter headings in the centre. Running text in one column with a historiated initial O. Marginal notes in the right margin beside the text. Signature mark at the foot right.

main_text.head: SYNOPSIS SANAE ET VETERIS DOCTRINAE de S. Trinitate, ex orthodoxis Symbolis, & veteribus Synodis collecta, atque primo Sententiarum P. Lombardi libro opposita.
CAP. I.
Commendatio orthodoxae fidei de S. Trinitate.
main_text.p: Confer cum Distinct. 2. lib. 1. Sententiarum P. Lombardi.
main_text.head: Ex Athanasii symbolo.
main_text.p: Quicunque vult esse saluus, ante omnia opus est ut teneat Catholicam fidem: quam nisi quisque integram inviolatamque servaverit, absque dubio in aeternum peribit.Proemium commendationem orthodoxae fidei de S. Trinitate continens.
main_text.head: Toletano VI.
main_text.p: Quamobrem ex abundantia nostri cordis fit confessio vocis, ut fidem, quam omnium mens intrinsecus gestat, in confessione interpres lingua foris effundat.Confitendum ore, quod pie corde creditur.
main_text.head: CAP. II.
Summa orthodoxae fidei de S. Trinitate.
main_text.p: Confer cum Distinct. 2. lib. 1. Sententiarum Petri Lombardi.

page.notes: Woodcut initial O and ornament band are not transcribed. Marginal notes were partly damaged and read with uncertainty. The line "Commendatio" and the ornament at the top are typographically heavy and some letters are uncertain.
